japaneseDescription: The surface of this Pokémon’s skin hardens when exposed to intense heat, and its body has an appetizing aroma.

englishDescription: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.
chineseDescription: 会把养分转换成油，保存在头上的果实里。整整一星期不吃不喝也没问题。
traditionalChineseDescription: 會把養分轉換成油，儲存在頭上的果實裡。整整一星期不吃不喝也沒問題。
japaneseDescription: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.

englishDescription: It basks in the sun to its heart’s content until the fruits on its head ripen. After that, Dolliv departs from human settlements and goes on a journey.
chineseDescription: 尽情晒太阳，直到头上的果实成熟。之后奥利纽就会离开人类的聚落，踏上旅程。
traditionalChineseDescription: 盡情曬太陽，直到頭上的果實成熟。之後奧利紐就會離開人類的聚落，踏上旅程。
japaneseDescription: It basks in the sun to its heart’s content until the fruits on its head ripen. After that, Dolliv departs from human settlements and goes on a journey.

englishDescription: This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder.
chineseDescription: 会把浓郁芬芳的油以足以击碎巨石的力道射向敌人，将其击退。
traditionalChineseDescription: 會把濃郁芬芳的油以足以擊碎巨石的力道射向敵人，將其擊退。
japaneseDescription: This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder.

englishDescription: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they’re out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.
chineseDescription: 绿色羽毛的群体势力最大。早晚外出觅食时会非常吵闹。
traditionalChineseDescription: 綠色羽毛的群體勢力最大。早晚外出覓食時會非常吵鬧。
japaneseDescription: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they’re out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

englishDescription: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli’s body.
chineseDescription: 移动时地面会摩擦身体，使盐掉落下来。盐石宝体内会不断生成并补充盐分。
traditionalChineseDescription: 移動時地面會摩擦身體，使鹽掉落下來。鹽石寶體內會不斷生成並補充鹽分。
japaneseDescription: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli’s body.

englishDescription: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.
chineseDescription: 在体内压缩岩盐，射出硬化的盐弹，力道足以贯穿铁板。
traditionalChineseDescription: 在體內壓縮岩鹽，射出硬化的鹽彈，力道足以貫穿鐵板。
japaneseDescription: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.

englishDescription: Many Pokémon gather around Garganacl, hoping to lick at its mineral-rich salt.
chineseDescription: 许多宝可梦会聚集在盐石巨灵身边，想舔食它富含矿物质的盐。
traditionalChineseDescription: 許多寶可夢會聚集在鹽石巨靈身邊，想舔食牠富含礦物質的鹽。
japaneseDescription: Many Pokémon gather around Garganacl, hoping to lick at its mineral-rich salt.

englishDescription: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.
chineseDescription: 战斗时火力会增强，可达1000度以上。喜欢富含油脂的树果。
traditionalChineseDescription: 戰鬥時火力會增強，可達1000度以上。喜歡富含油脂的樹果。
japaneseDescription: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

englishDescription: This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been fortified by psychic and fire energy, and it shoots blazing fireballs.
chineseDescription: 身穿以超能力和火焰能量强化过的铠甲，射出炽热的火球。
traditionalChineseDescription: 身穿以超能力和火焰能量強化過的鎧甲，射出熾熱的火球。
japaneseDescription: This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been fortified by psychic and fire energy, and it shoots blazing fireballs.

englishDescription: An old set of armor steeped in grudges caused this Pokémon’s evolution. Ceruledge cuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.
chineseDescription: 一套浸染着怨念的古老铠甲促成了它的进化。苍炎刃鬼会毫不留情地把敌人斩成碎片。
traditionalChineseDescription: 一套浸染著怨念的古老鎧甲促成了牠的進化。蒼炎刃鬼會毫不留情地把敵人斬成碎片。
japaneseDescription: An old set of armor steeped in grudges caused this Pokémon’s evolution. Ceruledge cuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.

englishDescription: It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground.
chineseDescription: 利用体内保存的电飘浮。附近有雷云时，光蚪仔会飘得更高。
traditionalChineseDescription: 利用體內儲存的電飄浮。附近有雷雲時，光蚪仔會飄得更高。
japaneseDescription: It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground.

englishDescription: What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs for discharging the electricity generated by Bellibolt’s belly-button dynamo.
chineseDescription: 看起来像眼球的部分，其实是用来释放肚脐发电机所产生电力的器官。
traditionalChineseDescription: 看起來像眼球的部分，其實是用來釋放肚臍發電機所產生電力的器官。
japaneseDescription: What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs for discharging the electricity generated by Bellibolt’s belly-button dynamo.

englishDescription: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they’re a popular delicacy.
chineseDescription: 在海岸的悬崖上筑巢。巢有着奇特的酥脆口感，是很受欢迎的美食。
traditionalChineseDescription: 在海岸的懸崖上築巢。巢有著奇特的酥脆口感，是很受歡迎的美食。
japaneseDescription: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they’re a popular delicacy.

englishDescription: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There’s hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.
chineseDescription: 用喉囊保存翅膀产生的电。羽毛几乎不含油脂，所以不擅长游泳。
traditionalChineseDescription: 用喉囊儲存翅膀產生的電。羽毛幾乎不含油脂，所以不擅長游泳。
japaneseDescription: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There’s hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

englishDescription: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.
chineseDescription: 发达的下腭和牙齿强壮到能咬碎巨石，厚厚的脂肪也是绝佳的防御。
traditionalChineseDescription: 發達的下顎和牙齒強壯到能咬碎巨石，厚厚的脂肪也是絕佳的防禦。
japaneseDescription: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

englishDescription: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.
chineseDescription: 喜欢和小孩玩。平常很温和，但保护家人时会露出吓人的表情。
traditionalChineseDescription: 喜歡和小孩玩。平常很溫和，但保護家人時會露出嚇人的表情。
japaneseDescription: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

englishDescription: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.
chineseDescription: 为了不让敌人靠近地盘，会用有刺鼻气味的毒液在巢穴周围画上记号。
traditionalChineseDescription: 為了不讓敵人靠近地盤，會用有刺鼻氣味的毒液在巢穴周圍畫上記號。
japaneseDescription: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.

englishDescription: Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.
chineseDescription: 每只涂标客都有自己独特的图案，而且一辈子都会反复画同一个图案。
traditionalChineseDescription: 每隻塗標客都有自己獨特的圖案，而且一輩子都會反覆畫同一個圖案。
japaneseDescription: Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.

englishDescription: Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet.
chineseDescription: 被风吹着在荒野中翻滚，连纳噬草自己都不知道要往哪里去。非常讨厌弄湿。
traditionalChineseDescription: 被風吹著在荒野中翻滾，連納噬草自己都不知道要往哪裡去。非常討厭弄濕。
japaneseDescription: Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet.

englishDescription: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.
chineseDescription: 在干燥地区四处游荡。偶尔会发生大量出现的现象，把整座城镇掩埋。
traditionalChineseDescription: 在乾燥地區四處遊蕩。偶爾會發生大量出現的現象，把整座城鎮掩埋。
japaneseDescription: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.

englishDescription: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.
chineseDescription: 虽然长得像玛瑙水母，却是完全不同的物种。腿虽然细，却能以时速50公里奔跑。
traditionalChineseDescription: 雖然長得像瑪瑙水母，卻是完全不同的物種。腿雖然細，卻能以時速50公里奔跑。
japaneseDescription: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

englishDescription: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.
chineseDescription: 用10条触手缠住猎物吸取养分，让猎物痛苦不堪。头部边缘的皱褶是很受欢迎的美食。
traditionalChineseDescription: 用10條觸手纏住獵物吸取養分，讓獵物痛苦不堪。頭部邊緣的皺褶是很受歡迎的美食。
japaneseDescription: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

englishDescription: This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs. It sidesteps opponents’ attacks, then lunges for their weak spots with its claws.
chineseDescription: 栖息在陡峭的悬崖上。侧身闪过对手的攻击后，用钳子直扑对方的弱点。
traditionalChineseDescription: 棲息在陡峭的懸崖上。側身閃過對手的攻擊後，用鉗子直撲對方的弱點。
japaneseDescription: This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs. It sidesteps opponents’ attacks, then lunges for their weak spots with its claws.

englishDescription: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.
chineseDescription: 帕底亚的传统料理之所以极辣，是因为食材中加入了热辣娃脱落的门牙。
traditionalChineseDescription: 帕底亞的傳統料理之所以極辣，是因為食材中加入了熱辣娃脫落的門牙。
japaneseDescription: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

englishDescription: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.
chineseDescription: 绿色的头因为受到辛辣化学物质刺激脑部而变得凶暴。一旦开始暴走就无法阻止。
traditionalChineseDescription: 綠色的頭因為受到辛辣化學物質刺激腦部而變得兇暴。一旦開始暴走就無法阻止。
japaneseDescription: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

englishDescription: It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time comes for it to evolve.
chineseDescription: 一边滚动泥球，一边等待进化所需的能量成熟。终有一天会迎来进化的时刻。
traditionalChineseDescription: 一邊滾動泥球，一邊等待進化所需的能量成熟。終有一天會迎來進化的時刻。
japaneseDescription: It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time comes for it to evolve.

englishDescription: An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.
chineseDescription: 球里睡着一个婴儿。虫甲圣会用脚轻柔地滚动球体，让婴儿睡得安稳。
traditionalChineseDescription: 球裡睡著一個嬰兒。蟲甲聖會用腳輕柔地滾動球體，讓嬰兒睡得安穩。
japaneseDescription: An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.

englishDescription: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.
chineseDescription: 整天在荒地上四处奔跑。要是有人偷走它心爱的树果，它会追上去报仇。
traditionalChineseDescription: 整天在荒地上四處奔跑。要是有人偷走牠心愛的樹果，牠會追上去報仇。
japaneseDescription: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.

englishDescription: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.
chineseDescription: 从多彩的颈饰缝隙间释放超能力，以超过时速200公里的速度奔驰。
traditionalChineseDescription: 從多彩的頸飾縫隙間釋放超能力，以超過時速200公里的速度奔馳。
japaneseDescription: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.

englishDescription: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it’s satisfied with the result.
chineseDescription: 把废铁敲打在一起制成锤子。会一次又一次地重做，直到满意为止。
traditionalChineseDescription: 把廢鐵敲打在一起製成鎚子。會一次又一次地重做，直到滿意為止。
japaneseDescription: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it’s satisfied with the result.

englishDescription: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other’s hammers by smashing them together.
chineseDescription: 以废铁堆为家。它们会互相撞击锤子来测试彼此锤子的强度。
traditionalChineseDescription: 以廢鐵堆為家。牠們會互相撞擊鎚子來測試彼此鎚子的強度。
japaneseDescription: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other’s hammers by smashing them together.

englishDescription: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.
chineseDescription: 锤子重达100公斤以上，巨锻匠却能轻松挥舞，随心所欲地抢夺东西并带回家。
traditionalChineseDescription: 鎚子重達100公斤以上，巨鍛匠卻能輕鬆揮舞，隨心所欲地搶奪東西並帶回家。
japaneseDescription: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

englishDescription: Though it looks like Diglett, Wiglett is an entirely different species. The resemblance seems to be a coincidental result of environmental adaptation.
chineseDescription: 虽然长得像地鼠，却是完全不同的物种。相似之处似乎是适应环境的巧合。
traditionalChineseDescription: 雖然長得像地鼠，卻是完全不同的物種。相似之處似乎是適應環境的巧合。
japaneseDescription: Though it looks like Diglett, Wiglett is an entirely different species. The resemblance seems to be a coincidental result of environmental adaptation.

englishDescription: A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio.
chineseDescription: 一种鱼宝可梦，曾一度被认为是三地鼠的地区形态。
traditionalChineseDescription: 一種魚寶可夢，曾一度被認為是三地鼠的地區形態。
japaneseDescription: A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio.

englishDescription: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.
chineseDescription: 用胸前的围裙把食物包起来带回巢穴。喜欢丢下会发出巨大声响的东西。
traditionalChineseDescription: 用胸前的圍裙把食物包起來帶回巢穴。喜歡丟下會發出巨大聲響的東西。
japaneseDescription: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

englishDescription: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.
chineseDescription: 它的水环是由海水混合从喷气孔分泌的黏液制成的。
traditionalChineseDescription: 牠的水環是由海水混合從噴氣孔分泌的黏液製成的。
japaneseDescription: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.

englishDescription: Its physical capabilities are no different than a Finizen’s, but when its allies are in danger, it transforms and powers itself up.
chineseDescription: 身体能力和波普海豚没有差别，但当伙伴遇到危险时，就会变身并提升力量。
traditionalChineseDescription: 身體能力和波普海豚沒有差別，但當夥伴遇到危險時，就會變身並提升力量。
japaneseDescription: Its physical capabilities are no different than a Finizen’s, but when its allies are in danger, it transforms and powers itself up.

englishDescription: The steel section is Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.
chineseDescription: 钢铁的部分才是噗隆隆真正的身体。它会附着在岩石上，把其中的矿物转换成活动所需的能量。
traditionalChineseDescription: 鋼鐵的部分才是噗隆隆真正的身體。牠會附著在岩石上，把其中的礦物轉換成活動所需的能量。
japaneseDescription: The steel section is Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

englishDescription: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.
chineseDescription: 用排气声凶狠地威吓对方。会从圆筒状的嘴里伸出舌头，喷洒有毒的液体。
traditionalChineseDescription: 用排氣聲兇狠地威嚇對方。會從圓筒狀的嘴裡伸出舌頭，噴灑有毒的液體。
japaneseDescription: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.

englishDescription: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider’s body heat warms Cyclizar’s back and lifts the Pokémon’s spirit.
chineseDescription: 载着人也能以超过时速110公里奔驰。骑乘者的体温温暖了它的背，让它精神大振。
traditionalChineseDescription: 載著人也能以超過時速110公里奔馳。騎乘者的體溫溫暖了牠的背，讓牠精神大振。
japaneseDescription: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider’s body heat warms Cyclizar’s back and lifts the Pokémon’s spirit.

englishDescription: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It maintains its metal body by consuming iron from the soil.
chineseDescription: 栖息在干燥的沙漠。靠摄取土壤中的铁来维持金属的身体。
traditionalChineseDescription: 棲息在乾燥的沙漠。靠攝取土壤中的鐵來維持金屬的身體。
japaneseDescription: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It maintains its metal body by consuming iron from the soil.

englishDescription: Glimmet’s toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.
chineseDescription: 有毒的矿物结晶看起来就像花瓣。会像撒花粉一样撒出毒粉保护自己。
traditionalChineseDescription: 有毒的礦物結晶看起來就像花瓣。會像撒花粉一樣撒出毒粉保護自己。
japaneseDescription: Glimmet’s toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.

englishDescription: Glimmora’s petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.
chineseDescription: 花瓣由结晶化的毒能量构成。最近发现这些花瓣与太晶宝石十分相似。
traditionalChineseDescription: 花瓣由結晶化的毒能量構成。最近發現這些花瓣與太晶寶石十分相似。
japaneseDescription: Glimmora’s petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.

englishDescription: This friendly Pokémon doesn’t like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.
chineseDescription: 亲人的宝可梦，不喜欢独处。只要稍微关注它一下，它就会永远跟着你。
traditionalChineseDescription: 親人的寶可夢，不喜歡獨處。只要稍微關注牠一下，牠就會永遠跟著你。
japaneseDescription: This friendly Pokémon doesn’t like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

englishDescription: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn’t like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.
chineseDescription: 受人深深悼念的宝可梦转生成了墓扬犬。不喜欢任何人碰触它头顶的突起。
traditionalChineseDescription: 受人深深悼念的寶可夢轉生成了墓揚犬。不喜歡任何人碰觸牠頭頂的突起。
japaneseDescription: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn’t like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

englishDescription: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.
chineseDescription: 多亏一种称为「同步」的习性，整群缠红鹤能完美协调地同时发动攻击。
traditionalChineseDescription: 多虧一種稱為「同步」的習性，整群纏紅鶴能完美協調地同時發動攻擊。
japaneseDescription: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.

englishDescription: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.
chineseDescription: 以五只左右的群体栖息在寒冷地区。喜欢雪和冰中所含的矿物质。
traditionalChineseDescription: 以五隻左右的群體棲息在寒冷地區。喜歡雪和冰中所含的礦物質。
japaneseDescription: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

englishDescription: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.
chineseDescription: 冰的能量在上腭的角里累积，使角达到极低温，把周围冻结。
traditionalChineseDescription: 冰的能量在上顎的角裡累積，使角達到極低溫，把周圍凍結。
japaneseDescription: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

englishDescription: Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey.
chineseDescription: 再生能力极佳。会舍弃身上多余的肉来提升敏捷度，然后冲向猎物。
traditionalChineseDescription: 再生能力極佳。會捨棄身上多餘的肉來提升敏捷度，然後衝向獵物。
japaneseDescription: Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey.

englishDescription: It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very smart.
chineseDescription: 把米立龙当成老大，忠心耿耿地跟随。虽然很强，吃吼霸似乎不太聪明。
traditionalChineseDescription: 把米立龍當成老大，忠心耿耿地跟隨。雖然很強，吃吼霸似乎不太聰明。
japaneseDescription: It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very smart.

englishDescription: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.
chineseDescription: 极为狡猾的宝可梦。会假装虚弱引诱猎物上钩，再命令伙伴攻击。
traditionalChineseDescription: 極為狡猾的寶可夢。會假裝虛弱引誘獵物上鉤，再命令夥伴攻擊。
japaneseDescription: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.

englishDescription: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.
chineseDescription: 把藏在心底的愤怒力量灌注于拳头。被这种拳头击中的对手会从内心深处彻底崩溃。
traditionalChineseDescription: 把藏在心底的憤怒力量灌注於拳頭。被這種拳頭擊中的對手會從內心深處徹底崩潰。
japaneseDescription: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

englishDescription: It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps. It will carry Wooper on its back and ferry them across water from one shore to the other.
chineseDescription: 栖息在池塘和沼泽底部。会把乌波背在背上，载它们渡水到对岸。
traditionalChineseDescription: 棲息在池塘和沼澤底部。會把烏波背在背上，載牠們渡水到對岸。
japaneseDescription: It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps. It will carry Wooper on its back and ferry them across water from one shore to the other.

englishDescription: The hardened head from the tail protects the head of the main body as Farigiraf whips its long neck around to headbutt enemies.
chineseDescription: 尾巴硬化而成的头会保护本体的头，让奇麒麟能甩动长脖子用头撞击敌人。
traditionalChineseDescription: 尾巴硬化而成的頭會保護本體的頭，讓奇麒麟能甩動長脖子用頭撞擊敵人。
japaneseDescription: The hardened head from the tail protects the head of the main body as Farigiraf whips its long neck around to headbutt enemies.

englishDescription: It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs, then releasing the air in an intense blast.
chineseDescription: 吸入大量空气填满狭长的肺部，再猛烈喷出，把敌人赶出巢穴。
traditionalChineseDescription: 吸入大量空氣填滿狹長的肺部，再猛烈噴出，把敵人趕出巢穴。
japaneseDescription: It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs, then releasing the air in an intense blast.

englishDescription: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it’s not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.
chineseDescription: 虽然在战斗中指挥着庞大的军队，却不擅长拟定复杂的战术，只会靠蛮力不断推进。
traditionalChineseDescription: 雖然在戰鬥中指揮著龐大的軍隊，卻不擅長擬定複雜的戰術，只會靠蠻力不斷推進。
japaneseDescription: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it’s not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.

englishDescription: This creature resembles a mysterious Pokémon that, according to a paranormal magazine, has lived since ancient times.
chineseDescription: 这个生物很像某本超自然杂志中记载、据说从远古时代就存活至今的神秘宝可梦。
traditionalChineseDescription: 這個生物很像某本超自然雜誌中記載、據說從遠古時代就存活至今的神祕寶可夢。
japaneseDescription: This creature resembles a mysterious Pokémon that, according to a paranormal magazine, has lived since ancient times.

englishDescription: It resembles a mysterious Pokémon described in a paranormal magazine as a Jigglypuff from one billion years ago.
chineseDescription: 很像某本超自然杂志中描述为「10亿年前的胖丁」的神秘宝可梦。
traditionalChineseDescription: 很像某本超自然雜誌中描述為「10億年前的胖丁」的神祕寶可夢。
japaneseDescription: It resembles a mysterious Pokémon described in a paranormal magazine as a Jigglypuff from one billion years ago.

englishDescription: It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.
chineseDescription: 和一本可疑杂志中描述为恐龙与蘑菇混合体的宝可梦有几分相似。
traditionalChineseDescription: 和一本可疑雜誌中描述為恐龍與蘑菇混合體的寶可夢有幾分相似。
japaneseDescription: It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.

englishDescription: It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the two have little else in common.
chineseDescription: 与超自然杂志报导过的幽灵翼龙有相似的特征，除此之外两者几乎没有共同点。
traditionalChineseDescription: 與超自然雜誌報導過的幽靈翼龍有相似的特徵，除此之外兩者幾乎沒有共同點。
japaneseDescription: It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the two have little else in common.

englishDescription: This Pokémon somewhat resembles an ancient form of Volcarona that was introduced in a dubious magazine.
chineseDescription: 这只宝可梦有点像一本可疑杂志中介绍的火神蛾的远古形态。
traditionalChineseDescription: 這隻寶可夢有點像一本可疑雜誌中介紹的火神蛾的遠古形態。
japaneseDescription: This Pokémon somewhat resembles an ancient form of Volcarona that was introduced in a dubious magazine.

englishDescription: It slightly resembles a Magneton that lived for 10,000 years and was featured in an article in a paranormal magazine.
chineseDescription: 略似超自然杂志文章中刊载的、活了一万年的三合一磁怪。
traditionalChineseDescription: 略似超自然雜誌文章中刊載的、活了一萬年的三合一磁怪。
japaneseDescription: It slightly resembles a Magneton that lived for 10,000 years and was featured in an article in a paranormal magazine.

englishDescription: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.
chineseDescription: 近年才有人目击到这只宝可梦。它很像一本古老探险日志中描述的神秘物体。
traditionalChineseDescription: 近年才有人目擊到這隻寶可夢。牠很像一本古老探險日誌中描述的神祕物體。
japaneseDescription: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.

englishDescription: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.
chineseDescription: 很像一本古书中提到的神秘物体。关于这只宝可梦的目击报告只有两件。
traditionalChineseDescription: 很像一本古書中提到的神祕物體。關於這隻寶可夢的目擊報告只有兩件。
japaneseDescription: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.

englishDescription: This Pokémon shares many similarities with Iron Hands, an object mentioned in a certain expedition journal.
chineseDescription: 这只宝可梦与某本探险日志中提到的「铁臂膀」有许多相似之处。
traditionalChineseDescription: 這隻寶可夢與某本探險日誌中提到的「鐵臂膀」有許多相似之處。
japaneseDescription: This Pokémon shares many similarities with Iron Hands, an object mentioned in a certain expedition journal.

englishDescription: It’s possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.
chineseDescription: 古书中描述的物体「铁脖颈」，有可能其实就是这只宝可梦。
traditionalChineseDescription: 古書中描述的物體「鐵脖頸」，有可能其實就是這隻寶可夢。
japaneseDescription: It’s possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.

englishDescription: No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with an object described in an old book.
chineseDescription: 没有任何捕获这个物种的纪录。数据虽然不足，但它的特征与古书中描述的物体吻合。
traditionalChineseDescription: 沒有任何捕獲這個物種的紀錄。資料雖然不足，但牠的特徵與古書中描述的物體吻合。
japaneseDescription: No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with an object described in an old book.

englishDescription: Some of its notable features match those of an object named within a certain expedition journal as Iron Thorns.
chineseDescription: 它的一些显著特征，与某本探险日志中名为「铁荆棘」的物体相符。
traditionalChineseDescription: 牠的一些顯著特徵，與某本探險日誌中名為「鐵荊棘」的物體相符。
japaneseDescription: Some of its notable features match those of an object named within a certain expedition journal as Iron Thorns.

englishDescription: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.
chineseDescription: 栖息在森林和岩石地带。利用背鳍的力量，把巢穴内部冷却得像冰箱一样。
traditionalChineseDescription: 棲息在森林和岩石地帶。利用背鰭的力量，把巢穴內部冷卻得像冰箱一樣。
japaneseDescription: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.

englishDescription: It attacks with the blade of its frozen dorsal fin by doing a front flip in the air. Arctibax’s strong back and legs allow it to pull off this technique.
chineseDescription: 在空中前空翻，用冰冻的背鳍之刃攻击。冻脊龙强壮的背部和腿让它能施展这招。
traditionalChineseDescription: 在空中前空翻，用冰凍的背鰭之刃攻擊。凍脊龍強壯的背部和腿讓牠能施展這招。
japaneseDescription: It attacks with the blade of its frozen dorsal fin by doing a front flip in the air. Arctibax’s strong back and legs allow it to pull off this technique.

englishDescription: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.
chineseDescription: 倒转身体、从嘴里喷出冰冷的空气冲入战场，再用背上的刃解决对手。
traditionalChineseDescription: 倒轉身體、從嘴裡噴出冰冷的空氣衝入戰場，再用背上的刃解決對手。
japaneseDescription: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.

englishDescription: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.
chineseDescription: 住在古老的宝箱里。有时会被遗忘在店铺的角落，因为没人发现它其实是宝可梦。
traditionalChineseDescription: 住在古老的寶箱裡。有時會被遺忘在店鋪的角落，因為沒人發現牠其實是寶可夢。
japaneseDescription: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.

englishDescription: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.
chineseDescription: 身体由堆栈的硬币构成，十分坚固。会连续快速射出硬币，压制敌人。
traditionalChineseDescription: 身體由堆疊的硬幣構成，十分堅固。會連續快速射出硬幣，壓制敵人。
japaneseDescription: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.

englishDescription: It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to turn barren.
chineseDescription: 会吸取植物的生命力，使附近的森林瞬间枯萎、田地变得荒芜。
traditionalChineseDescription: 會吸取植物的生命力，使附近的森林瞬間枯萎、田地變得荒蕪。
japaneseDescription: It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to turn barren.

englishDescription: The hatred of those who perished by the sword long ago has clad itself in snow and become a Pokémon.
chineseDescription: 很久以前死于刀剑之下的人们的仇恨，裹上白雪化为了宝可梦。
traditionalChineseDescription: 很久以前死於刀劍之下的人們的仇恨，裹上白雪化為了寶可夢。
japaneseDescription: The hatred of those who perished by the sword long ago has clad itself in snow and become a Pokémon.

englishDescription: It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.
chineseDescription: 会把极为沉重的头慢慢砸向地面，让大地裂开深达50公尺以上的巨大裂缝。
traditionalChineseDescription: 會把極為沉重的頭慢慢砸向地面，讓大地裂開深達50公尺以上的巨大裂縫。
japaneseDescription: It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.

englishDescription: The envy accumulated within curved beads that sparked multiple conflicts has clad itself in fire and become a Pokémon.
chineseDescription: 引发多次纷争的勾玉中累积的嫉妒，裹上火焰化为了宝可梦。
traditionalChineseDescription: 引發多次紛爭的勾玉中累積的嫉妒，裹上火焰化為了寶可夢。
japaneseDescription: The envy accumulated within curved beads that sparked multiple conflicts has clad itself in fire and become a Pokémon.

englishDescription: According to an article in a dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some connection to a phenomenon that occurs in a certain region.
chineseDescription: 根据一本可疑杂志的文章，这只宝可梦与某地区发生的一种现象有所关联。
traditionalChineseDescription: 根據一本可疑雜誌的文章，這隻寶可夢與某地區發生的一種現象有所關聯。
japaneseDescription: According to an article in a dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some connection to a phenomenon that occurs in a certain region.

englishDescription: It’s possible that this is the object listed as Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.
chineseDescription: 有可能就是某本探险日志中记载为「铁武者」的物体。
traditionalChineseDescription: 有可能就是某本探險日誌中記載為「鐵武者」的物體。
japaneseDescription: It’s possible that this is the object listed as Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.

englishDescription: This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar, but it is far burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is known about its ecology or other features.
chineseDescription: 外型像摩托蜥，但壮硕和凶猛程度远超过它。关于它的生态和其他特征一无所知。
traditionalChineseDescription: 外型像摩托蜥，但壯碩和兇猛程度遠超過牠。關於牠的生態和其他特徵一無所知。
japaneseDescription: This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar, but it is far burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is known about its ecology or other features.

englishDescription: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.
chineseDescription: 似乎就是古书中提到的「铁之蛇」。据说铁之蛇曾用雷电把大地化为灰烬。
traditionalChineseDescription: 似乎就是古書中提到的「鐵之蛇」。據說鐵之蛇曾用雷電把大地化為灰燼。
japaneseDescription: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

englishDescription: It resembles an illustration published in a paranormal magazine, said to be a depiction of a super-ancient Suicune.
chineseDescription: 很像某本超自然杂志刊登的插图，据说那是远古水君的描绘。
traditionalChineseDescription: 很像某本超自然雜誌刊登的插圖，據說那是遠古水君的描繪。
japaneseDescription: It resembles an illustration published in a paranormal magazine, said to be a depiction of a super-ancient Suicune.

englishDescription: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.
chineseDescription: 根据为数不多的目击证词，它曾用闪亮的刀刃把大树和巨石切成细条。
traditionalChineseDescription: 根據為數不多的目擊證詞，牠曾用閃亮的刀刃把大樹和巨石切成細條。
japaneseDescription: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.

englishDescription: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.
chineseDescription: 伸出来的头属于前龙，尾巴则属于核龙。两者共享一颗苹果，互相帮助。
traditionalChineseDescription: 伸出來的頭屬於前龍，尾巴則屬於核龍。兩者共享一顆蘋果，互相幫助。
japaneseDescription: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.

englishDescription: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.
chineseDescription: 看起来像来悲茶的地区形态，但最近发现两者完全没有关系。
traditionalChineseDescription: 看起來像來悲茶的地區形態，但最近發現兩者完全沒有關係。
japaneseDescription: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.

englishDescription: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.
chineseDescription: 喜欢阴凉黑暗的地方，例如架子深处或住家的地板下。日落后会四处游荡寻找猎物。
traditionalChineseDescription: 喜歡陰涼黑暗的地方，例如架子深處或住家的地板下。日落後會四處遊蕩尋找獵物。
japaneseDescription: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.

englishDescription: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.
chineseDescription: 脾气暴躁的恶霸。挥舞脖子上的锁链，能把任何东西粉碎。
traditionalChineseDescription: 脾氣暴躁的惡霸。揮舞脖子上的鎖鏈，能把任何東西粉碎。
japaneseDescription: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.

englishDescription: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.
chineseDescription: 会把自己藏在安全的地方，用念力让对手剧烈晕眩，借此戏弄对方。
traditionalChineseDescription: 會把自己藏在安全的地方，用念力讓對手劇烈暈眩，藉此戲弄對方。
japaneseDescription: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.

englishDescription: Fezandipiti beats its glossy wings to scatter pheromones that captivate people and Pokémon.
chineseDescription: 拍动有光泽的翅膀，撒出能迷住人类和宝可梦的费洛蒙。
traditionalChineseDescription: 拍動有光澤的翅膀，撒出能迷住人類和寶可夢的費洛蒙。
japaneseDescription: Fezandipiti beats its glossy wings to scatter pheromones that captivate people and Pokémon.

englishDescription: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.
chineseDescription: 喜欢恶作剧、充满好奇心的宝可梦。战斗时会引出面具中蕴含的属性能量。
traditionalChineseDescription: 喜歡惡作劇、充滿好奇心的寶可夢。戰鬥時會引出面具中蘊含的屬性能量。
japaneseDescription: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

englishDescription: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It’s so durable that being caught in a cave-in won’t faze it.
chineseDescription: 会在山上挖洞寻找食物。非常耐打，就算被坍方活埋也不当一回事。
traditionalChineseDescription: 會在山上挖洞尋找食物。非常耐打，就算被坍方活埋也不當一回事。
japaneseDescription: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It’s so durable that being caught in a cave-in won’t faze it.

englishDescription: These capricious syrpents have banded together. On the rare occasion that their moods align, their true power is unleashed.
chineseDescription: 这些反复无常的蜜蛇聚集在了一起。在它们心情难得一致的时候，真正的力量就会解放。
traditionalChineseDescription: 這些反覆無常的蜜蛇聚集在了一起。在牠們心情難得一致的時候，真正的力量就會解放。
japaneseDescription: These capricious syrpents have banded together. On the rare occasion that their moods align, their true power is unleashed.
japaneseGenus: りんごオロチポケモン

englishDescription: It resembles an eerie Pokémon once shown in a paranormal magazine. That Pokémon was said to be an Entei regenerated from a fossil.
chineseDescription: 很像超自然杂志曾刊登过的一只诡异宝可梦。据说那是从化石再生的炎帝。
traditionalChineseDescription: 很像超自然雜誌曾刊登過的一隻詭異寶可夢。據說那是從化石再生的炎帝。
japaneseDescription: It resembles an eerie Pokémon once shown in a paranormal magazine. That Pokémon was said to be an Entei regenerated from a fossil.
japaneseGenus: パラドックスポケモン

englishDescription: It bears resemblance to a Pokémon that became a hot topic for a short while after a paranormal magazine touted it as Raikou's ancestor.
chineseDescription: 很像一只曾短暂成为话题的宝可梦。某本超自然杂志宣称那是雷公的祖先。
traditionalChineseDescription: 很像一隻曾短暫成為話題的寶可夢。某本超自然雜誌宣稱那是雷公的祖先。
japaneseDescription: It bears resemblance to a Pokémon that became a hot topic for a short while after a paranormal magazine touted it as Raikou's ancestor.
japaneseGenus: パラドックスポケモン

englishDescription: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.
chineseDescription: 以古书中记载的神秘物体命名。身体似乎是金属制的。
traditionalChineseDescription: 以古書中記載的神祕物體命名。身體似乎是金屬製的。
japaneseDescription: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.
japaneseGenus: パラドックスポケモン

englishDescription: There was supposedly an incident in which it launched shining blades to cut everything around it to pieces. Little else is known about it.
chineseDescription: 据说曾发生过它射出闪亮刀刃、把周围一切切成碎片的事件。除此之外所知甚少。
traditionalChineseDescription: 據說曾發生過牠射出閃亮刀刃、把周圍一切切成碎片的事件。除此之外所知甚少。
japaneseDescription: There was supposedly an incident in which it launched shining blades to cut everything around it to pieces. Little else is known about it.
japaneseGenus: パラドックスポケモン

englishDescription: It’s thought that this Pokémon lived in ancient Paldea until it got caught in seismic shifts and went extinct.
chineseDescription: 据信这只宝可梦曾生活在远古的帕底亚，直到遭遇地壳变动而灭绝。
traditionalChineseDescription: 據信這隻寶可夢曾生活在遠古的帕底亞，直到遭遇地殼變動而滅絕。
japaneseDescription: It’s thought that this Pokémon lived in ancient Paldea until it got caught in seismic shifts and went extinct.

englishDescription: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.
chineseDescription: 桃子形状的外壳用来保存强效的毒。它会做有毒的麻糬，拿给人类和宝可梦吃。
traditionalChineseDescription: 桃子形狀的外殼用來儲存強效的毒。牠會做有毒的麻糬，拿給人類和寶可夢吃。
japaneseDescription: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.
